title: Mars Has a 5‑Year‑Old Underground River

scenes.text: Mars’ latest rover image reveals a 5‑year‑old underground river

scenes.label: WATER FLOWING
scenes.text: Infrared imaging shows liquid water seeping through basaltic layers

scenes.label: 3‑MILE LENGTH
scenes.text: The river stretches roughly 3 miles beneath the surface

scenes.label: EROSION MARKS
scenes.text: Distinct channels indicate erosion over millions of years
Follow for daily science that blows your mind.

description: A new rover image confirms a flowing underground river on Mars, stretching several miles below the surface. This challenges our understanding of Martian hydrology. Follow for daily science!
